column1: # Pass-to-phase roll-up for the per-phase tables of tools/bench/bench.py (PLAN.md §6).
# One line per pass name, as --tracer_mode=TIMING_ONLY prints it (PassFactory and
# Compiler.newTracer names); tab-separated. A pass missing here is reported under
# "other passes" and listed as unmapped in the report, so this file can be completed.
# Two pseudo-phases come from the timestamps rather than from passes: "startup" (process
# start or iteration start to the tracker's start) and "code printing and source maps"
# (the tracker's report to process exit or iteration end: toSource, the source map, writing
# the output, and process exit), since the report is printed before the output is generated.
